event.name: arrest_open
event.text: PA: All units. By order of the Presidency, garrison command is... recalibrated.

event.name: arrest_order
event.text: PA: General Balaceanu is relieved of command and arrested. Escort him out.

event.name: arrest_steer
event.text: VASILE: You don't need to see him. Trust me.

event.name: arrest_confusion
event.text: LOYALIST COMMS (JAMMED): -say again- who gave the or- our channel's on every set-

event.name: arrest_standdown
event.text: SYSTEM: Guns down. That's the President on the wire. They're taking the General.

event.name: arrest_retreat
event.text: LOYALIST COMMS: Fall back! Nobody dies for a man already in a cell. Break off!
